description: Cori KNL: 70% of the nodes active at night (22:00 to 06:00), 30% shut down

_comments.drain_lead_time: seconds before the window start at which draining begins
_comments.max_drain_duration: absolute timeout of the DRAINING state in seconds
_comments.target_fraction: fraction of the nodes that stays active during the window; the rest is shut down
_comments.malleable_shrink_to_target: true = shrink malleable jobs on targeted nodes to reach target_fraction
_comments.malleable_shrink_lead_time: seconds before the window start at which shrinking begins (for example 600 = 10 min)
_comments.malleable_shrink_priority: min|pref|average (priority order for selecting jobs to shrink)
_comments.shutdown_target_pool: true = reserve the shutdown subset and keep long jobs off the targeted nodes
